Question: \(A,\) \(B,\) and \(C\) are three piles of rocks. The mean weight of the rocks in \(A\) is \(40\) pounds, the mean weight of the rocks in \(B\) is \(50\) pounds, the mean weight of the rocks in the combined piles \(A\) and \(B\) is \(43\) pounds, and the mean weight of the rocks in the combined piles \(A\) and \(C\) is \(44\) pounds. What is the greatest possible integer value for the mean in pounds of the rocks in the combined piles \(B\) and \(C?\)
